description: North Carolina’s property tax homestead exclusion for disabled veterans would increase from $45,000 to $61,000 under a bill approved Tuesday in the House Homeland Security and Military and Veterans Affairs Committee.Currently, the first $45,000 of a disabled veterans’ assessed value of a permanent residence is exempt from property taxes.
